notes.content: Hey everyone! We have uploaded a new version with some minor fixes in NPC path-finding and text errors. Thank you as always for your support and happy holidays!

notes.title: Version 1.4 - Resources and ease of access
notes.content:
Part of our mission statement and the goal of this game is to provide resources to those in need. With that in mind, we have added a variety of resources to the main menu of the game. All the descriptions of the organizations are clickable and lead to their respective websites. Hopefully this will help someone find the information or help they need to fight depression!

Thanks for playing!
Stephen

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26168422/dafc4379d8976cd201fb10731818fc8d58b2f637.png[/img]

notes.title: Updates and Bug Fixes 1.3.2
notes.content: Hello! We have just released version 1.3.2 which has some minor graphical fixes, but more importantly fixes the glitch that has been skipping people to the last level of the game! Thank you all for your patience and for posting in the forums, we check them every day and that's how we get bugs patched as quickly as possible. Thank you again for playing!

notes.title: First Level - Tips and Tricks
notes.content:
Hello! This is Stephen here. We've seen that people have been having issues getting past the first area. While we wanted this level to be difficult, we didn't want it to be a breaking point for people. In order to make this area a little easier, we will direct your attention to the old woman living in the middle of town.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26168422/4b1a12c1a3da3e44ba3d7bf6306cddf083fe9f51.jpg[/img]

With a little bit of community service under your belt, the first area should be no problem.

Thank you everyone for checking out our game, hopefully we can make it a good experience for everyone!

- Stephen

notes.title: Shovel Knight Amiibo Contest
notes.content:
Hello! We are huge Shovel Knight fans here, so as a special event, we are giving away a Shovel Knight Amiibo to celebrate our launch!

In order to win, you need to find the three Shovel Knight references hidden in the game and send their location and a short description to our Twitter, Facebook, Email, or website! The first person to find all three wins!

Best of luck!
